joins: each Employee to its Customer, on Employee.EmployeeId = Customer.SupportRepId (declared key)
each Customer to its Invoice, on CustomerId (declared key)
measures: revenue: total of Invoice total, rounded to 2 places
order: highest revenue first, then lowest Employee id first, top 1
planner_note: Sum invoice totals of each support rep's customers and keep the largest.
text: Shows Employee first name, Employee last name and revenue, by Employee id, Employee first name and Employee last name. Reads Employee, Customer and Invoice. Highest revenue first, then lowest Employee id first, top 1.
